name: io.github.tonyyang0504/amazon_ads-mcp
description: Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products / Brands / Display) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Login with Amazon client id of the app approved for the Amazon Ads API; also sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The LWA client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LWA refresh token from the advertiser's consent (scope advertising::campaign_management); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Regional Amazon Ads API host: advertising-api.amazon.com (North America), advertising-api-eu.amazon.com (Europe) or advertising-api-fe.amazon.com (Far East).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_PROFILE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Advertising profile id (one per advertiser and marketplace, from GET /v2/profiles), sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AMAZON_ADS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
